description: React component for viewing and summarizing a specific note, including fetching note data from an API and displaying the note content and its summary.

methods.name: fetchNote
methods.description: Fetches the note data using getNote API and updates the state; handles errors by invoking onError.

methods.name: onSummarize
methods.description: Calls summarizeNote API to generate a summary for the note and updates the summary text; handles errors by invoking onError.
